newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FITNESS WORRIES PLAGUE TURKISH SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FITNESS WORRIES PLAGUE TURKISH SQUAD.

text.p: Turkey's coach Mustafa Denizli may have to make substantial changes to the team who beat the Netherlands for their World Cup qualifier against Belgium next Wednesday.
The Turks, who upset the Dutch 1-0 in a group seven game earlier this month, have key players in doubt for contrasting reasons.
Midfielder Abdullah Ercan and defender Alpay Ozalan are already ruled out due to an operation and suspension respectively, while question marks hang over other key elements in Denizli's defence.
Right-back Ilker Yagcioglu and fellow defender Ogun Temizkanoglu have both been pulled out of training.
Yagcioglu has a calf-muscle injury, while Trabzonspor captain Temizkanoglu is having treatment for neck and back pains.

Temizkanoglu was badly beaten by angry Trabzonspor supporters when he attended the funeral of a fan killed in a road accident following their 1-0 defeat by Kocaelispor in the Turkish Cup final last week.
Meanwhile, Fenerbahce's Tayfun Korkut has a bad stomach infection, Denizli said.
Defenders: Bulent Korkmaz (Galatasaray), Ogun Temizkanoglu (Trabzonspor), Ilker Yagcioglu (Fenerbahce), Recep Cetin (Besiktas), Tayfur Havutcu (Kocaelispor).

Midfielders - Tayfun Korkut (Fenerbahce), Oguz Cetin (Istanbulspor), Tolunay Kafkas (Trabzonspor), Tugay Kerimoglu (Galatasaray), Arif Erdem (Galatasaray), Mehmet Ozdilek (Besiktas), Hakan Unsal (Galatasaray).
Forwards - Hami Mandirali (Trabzobspor), Hakan Sukur (Galatasaray), Celil Sagir (Samsumspor), Oktay Derelioglu (Besiktas).
